diverge_model_internals_get_

some getter functions to access internals. may break for non-standard models.

Functions
diverge_model_internals_get_E
double* diverge_model_internals_get_E(
const 
diverge_model_t* 
model
)

returns the internally generated energies (nk*nkf, nb).

diverge_model_internals_common must have been called, otherwise NULL is returned.
